'''''BKFC 57: Palomino vs. Trout''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on February 2, 2024, at the [[Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood]] in [[Hollywood, Florida]], [[United States|USA]]. 

===Background===
The event was headlined by [[Luis Palomino]] against [[Austin Trout]] for the vacant BKFC Welterweight Championship.<ref name="BKFC57">{{cite web|url=https://www.thesportster.com/bkfc-mike-perry-vs-eddie-alvarez-ppv-buys/|title='It Sucks' BKFC Boss Reveals Mike Perry vs Eddie Alvarez PPV Buys|first=Frank|last=Yemi|publisher=The Sportster|date=December 8, 2023}}</ref> A women's flyweight bout with Christine Vicens and Sydney Smith was cancelled. An originally-scheduled flyweight bout between Matt Russo and Justin Street did not take place either.

At the post-press conference, BKFC CEO David Feldman said this event was the highest-grossing and attended event for a combat sporting event at the Seminole Hard Rock Casino with almost 6,000 people in attendance.<ref name="bkfc57"/>

'''Bonus awards'''

The following fighters were awarded bonuses:<ref name="bkfc57">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/live/X9-0TtdEJEM?si=eH1JQ2oWZx0nd6Tq&t=219|title=BKFC 57 HOLLYWOOD POST EVENT PRESS CONFERENCE - David Feldman announces bonuses|date=February 2, 2024|author=BKFC on YouTube|publisher=youtube.com}}</ref>
* '''Fight of the Night:''' Bryan Duran vs. Louie Lopez
* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Leonardo Perdomo and Justin Ibarrola
* '''Performance of the Night:''' Bryce Henry, Bryan Duran, John Michael Escoboza, Alberto Blas, Ryan Reber and Derek Perez

'''''BKFC Knucklemania IV''''' was a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on April 27, 2024.

===Background===
The event was headlined by ''King of Violence'' Champion [[Mike Perry (fighter)|Mike Perry]] against former [[Bare_Knuckle_Fighting_Championship#Middleweight_Championship|BKFC Middleweight Champion]] [[Thiago Alves (fighter)|Thiago Alves]]. [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Cruiserweight Championship|BKFC Cruiserweight World Champion]] and [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Light Heavyweight Championship|BKFC Light Heavyweight World Champion]] [[Lorenzo Hunt]] challenged [[Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship#Heavyweight Championship|BKFC Heavyweight World Champion]] [[Mick Terrill]] for the Heavyweight Championship in the co-main event. Former UFC fighter [[Todd Duffee]] debuted with the organization against [[Ben Rothwell]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=BKFC KNUCKLEMANIA IV |url=https://www.bkfc.com/events/bkfc-knucklemania-iv:b9fc1d96-fba3-46a3-8328-7557cc684185 |access-date=2024-03-30 |website=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championships}}</ref> Former [[WBO]] [[Interim championship|interim]] [[light middleweight]] boxing champion [[Alfredo Angulo]] made his debut against [[Jeremiah Riggs]].<ref name=":2" />

===Aftermath===
At the event, Founder David Feldman announced that [[Conor McGregor]] and his company "McGregor Sports and Entertainment" were now part owners of BKFC.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Damon |date=2024-04-28 |title=Conor McGregor becomes part owner of BKFC |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/4/28/24143313/conor-mcgregor-mcgregor-sports-and-entertainment-becomes-part-owner-of-bkfc |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=MMA Fighting |language=en}}</ref> Feldman announced that the venue was almost sold out at a little over 7,100 in attendance.<ref name="bkfcivpost">{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RafCEdnaqeY|title=BKFC Knucklemania IV: Post Event Press Conference|date=April 27, 2024|author=BKFC on YouTube|publisher=youtube.com}}</ref> Feldman also stated twelve additional unannounced bonuses would be given to the boxers.<ref name="bkfcivpost"/>

The following were the announced bonuses:<ref name="bkfcivpost"/>
* '''Fight of the Night:''' David Diaz vs. Shane Jordan
* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Alfredo Angulo

'''''BKFC 61 Connecticut: Rivera vs. Straus''''' is a [[bare-knuckle fighting]] event held by Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship on May 11, 2024.

===Background===
Former UFC fighter [[Jimmie Rivera]] was featured in the main event against two-time [[List of Bellator champions#Featherweight Championship|Bellator Featherweight World Champion]] [[Daniel Straus (fighter)|Daniel Straus]].<ref name=":1" /><ref name="bkfc61newmain">{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Damon |date=April 25, 2024 |title=Christine Ferea vs. Heather Hardy no longer happening at the BKFC 61 event on May 11. Injury delays that one. |url=https://twitter.com/DamonMartin/status/1783206453714780291 |access-date=April 25, 2024 |website=Damon Martin of MMAFighting.com on X}}</ref>

The main event was scheduled to be a women's bantamweight bout with former [[List_of_WBO_female_world_champions#Featherweight|WBO female featherweight boxing]] champion [[Heather Hardy]] in her debut taking on [[Bare_Knuckle_Fighting_Championship#Women's_Flyweight_Championship|BKFC Women's Flyweight Champion]] [[Christine Ferea]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=BKFC 61 Rivera vs Straus |url=https://www.bkfc.com/events/bkfc-61-rivera-vs-straus:4be9fdd9-c783-4bee-8e8d-b789756db4f1 |access-date=2024-04-24 |website=Bare Knuckle Fighting Championships}}</ref> However, due to health issues relating to Hardy, the bout was scrapped.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Martin |first=Damon |date=2024-05-06 |title=Heather Hardy reveals career likely over due to 'too much brain damage' |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/5/6/24150545/heather-hardy-reveals-career-likely-over-due-to-too-much-brain-damage |access-date=2024-05-07 |website=MMA Fighting |language=en}}</ref> This pushed the Rivera vs. Straus bout to the main event.<ref name="bkfc61newmain"/>

Former UFC fighter [[Michael Trizano]] and former [[Bellator MMA]] fighter [[Derek Campos]] were set to face each other in their BKFC debuts.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Santiago |first=Christopher De |date=2024-04-17 |title='The Ultimate Fighter' Champion Says Goodbye to UFC, Hello to BKFC in New Signing |url=https://athlonsports.com/nation/mma/ufc/bkfc-signs-tuf-27-champion-mike-trizano |access-date=2024-05-04 |website=MMA and UFC News, Rumors & Analysis - Athlon Sports Nation |language=en}}</ref> However, in early May 2024, the bout was removed for unknown reasons.<ref name="bkfc61newmain" /> Trizano ended up facing Louie Lopez instead.<ref name="bkfc61newmain" /> 

Former [[Bellator MMA]] lightweight title contender [[Rick Hawn]] made his debut at this event as well.<ref name=":1" /> Former UFC fighter [[Louis Gaudinot]] was expected to face Sean Santella, but the bout was removed for unknown reasons on April 24, 2024.

MMA media personalities Oscar Willis and Ben Davis also competed in a lightweight bout at this event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/8/26/24228993/mma-media-personalities-ben-davis-oscar-willis-set-to-fight-at-bkfc-67|title=MMA media personalities Ben Davis, Oscar Willis set to fight at BKFC 67|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Jed Meshew|date=2024-08-26|access-date=2024-08-27}}</ref>
